notes.title: PRO VERSION 2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43036042/2f2b72da77ed08213135c762573e0eacd7d38c63.png

PRO VERSION 2.0

Major update.

- Play all 40 levels at a new intensity with the difficulty level at "way too hard".
After finishing the 10 missions you will unlock the possibility to play everything again but at a way too hard difficulty. More enemy's aircraft, more machine guns, more wind, more bombers, more fun.

- And you will gain 10 new achievements, the gold ranks.
